stories.title: Binance outflows slow after reopening; full proof of reserves promised by Tuesday
stories.summary: Binance reopened withdrawals in stages on Sunday after the record hack. It says withdrawals spiked at first but are now trending sharply down, and that deposits are also significant. Its full proof of reserves (a public check that customer balances are fully backed) is now promised by Tuesday 3 Nov (UTC).
points: About $4.6B was withdrawn against about $1B deposited, per Brad Feld. Reuters puts the net outflow at about $3.64B, or 2.1% of Binance's assets.
Cointelegraph, citing DefiLlama, reported a larger $5.8B net outflow over the preceding 24 hours. The two figures cover different time windows.
Binance says it has replaced 95% of the roughly $6.3B stolen with its own money, per Reuters, up from 80% on Friday and 90% on Saturday, per Brad Feld.
Co-CEO Yi He says half of the $1B SAFU user-protection fund will be used, then topped back up, per Reuters.
The full proof takes 40 to 50 hours of computing, so Binance moved it from Monday to Tuesday 3 Nov (UTC), per Brad Feld.

stories.title: North Korea money trail: $242M laundered via Tron routes; THORChain glitch slowed it
stories.summary: US agencies blame North Korea's TraderTraitor group for the hack. The hackers keep swapping stolen coins through decentralized services that are hard to freeze. The FBI has asked THORChain node operators and others to block listed addresses; the request is voluntary.
points: Elliptic: $2.85B of the $6.43B stolen, about 44%, has been frozen.
Other counts put the bitcoin haul at 18,270 BTC, about $1.4B, which is more than Tesla holds, per Seoul Economic Daily.
About $242M was laundered off Tron in two days through Relay, THORChain, Chainflip, Symbiosis and Bitget Wallet, per an analyst cited by The Block. Tether froze 378.7M USDT.
THORChain halted trading on 12 of its 13 chains for hours after an Ethereum glitch caused a 10 ETH double refund, per Bitcoin.com News. Chainalysis says this delayed the laundering.

stories.title: Fearful market waits for Tuesday's midterms; crypto PACs spent about $170M
stories.summary: Bitcoin is recovering from a six-week low hit on Friday, per Reuters, while traders wait for Tuesday's US midterm elections, which decide who writes the next round of crypto rules. Investors pulled money from crypto funds on the last trading day of October.
points: Spot bitcoin ETFs lost $643.2M on Friday 30 Oct, the biggest daily outflow since June; spot ether ETFs lost $155.7M, per Farside data reported by crypto.news.
The three main crypto super PACs spent about $170M, including nearly $56M against Sherrod Brown in Ohio, per CoinDesk. Other counts are higher: crypto.news says $176M.
Reuters says Democrats are widely expected to win the House, with the Senate less certain.
Bitcoin was about $77,976 at about 01:34 UTC Monday, per Reuters. Live prices are at the top of this page.

briefs.title: BTCPay Server hot wallets drained
briefs.summary: BTCPay warned late Sunday that attackers were sweeping hot wallets on self-hosted servers and told operators to shut them down. Founder Nicolas Dorier says attackers used older vulnerabilities; no loss total has been given.

briefs.title: Coinbase bitcoin discount at its widest this year
briefs.summary: The Coinbase premium index fell to about -0.06%, its lowest of 2026. Galaxy's Alex Thorn says the Binance withdrawal halt broke arbitrage, so it does not simply mean weaker US demand.

briefs.title: 50 companies object to OKX-ICE tokenized stocks
briefs.summary: Nvidia, Nike, Costco, Micron and Reddit are among 50 companies objecting, covering 44 of the 63 proposed tickers, per The Defiant.

briefs.title: Walmart-backed OnePay accepts USDC
briefs.summary: Select US users can deposit USDC from 12 blockchains into OnePay Checking, converted to dollars by Stripe's Bridge, with no fee at launch, per TokenPost.

briefs.title: Strategy hints at another buy
briefs.summary: Michael Saylor posted "We found room for even more orange" on Sunday. Strategy held 848,517 BTC; no new purchase has been announced, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Trump on the Binance hack
briefs.summary: "We're looking into it. I'm not worried," Trump said on 31 Oct, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: China targets crypto corruption
briefs.summary: A Communist Party resolution published 1 Nov orders a crackdown on corruption through virtual currency and blockchain; it adds no new trading ban, per crypto.news.
